correctness.rationale: For each r>=3 and n>=0, B_r(n)=binom(n+r-1,r-1) counts the exact uniform weak-composition sample. Z has expectation r B_{r-1}(n)/B_r(n). If H_r(n)=sum_{j=0}^{floor(n/2)}B_{r-2}(n-2j), the neighboring equal-pair mean is r H_r(n)/B_r(n). The r cyclic edges each have two marked adjacent vacancy indices, contributing 2 B_{r-2}, and r-2 other indices each contributing H_{r-1}, so E[ZE]=r(2B_{r-2}+(r-2)H_{r-1})/B_r. Subtracting means proves the exact general formula, including r=3, n=0 and n=1. Explicit parity expansions for H_2,...,H_5 in RESULT.md reproduce the six displayed rational expressions. A separately written exhaustive enumerator checked cyclic and linear covariances for r=3,4,5 and n=0..14; the general published all-k coefficient identity was independently specialized and checked against the six expressions for r=3,4,5 and n=0..500 (1593 exact comparisons in all). The universal proof rests on exact counting and algebra, not finite extrapolation. Seven real source blobs and the Git tree were inspected; the independent Git-tree hash reconstructed to the assigned f4fc205359ed8462f6f991c6a4b94f7b06f2c035.

value.rationale: The cyclic vacancy/equality covariance is a naturally interpretable statistic, but its complete six-case rational formula and phase behavior are straightforward reindexings and constant multiples of an already published all-k positive-composition covariance theorem. The new circular edge introduces no additional dependence structure because the vacancy statistic and the underlying law are exchangeable; every distinct unordered pair has the same mixed covariance. Consequently there is no independently useful new mathematical invariant, boundary or structural method after excluding covered content. A simpler presentation does not rescue scientific value as an original research result.
residual_risks: The finding can still have expository or pedagogical utility; that is not a new independent scientific contribution under the stated value standard.
